subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose global cron restart catch-up controls, add a per-job missed-run policy, or keep missed-job catch-up behavior internal for now?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but this adds a public scheduler/config contract and changes the tradeoff between duplicate user-facing deliveries and missed scheduled work.

options.title: Expose bounded global controls
options.body: Add validated global cron settings for maximum immediate missed jobs and stagger delay while keeping current defaults and documenting that they defer rather than skip unless explicitly changed.

options.title: Design per-job missed-run policy
options.body: Add an explicit job-level skip/run/time-window policy for announcement-style jobs where stale delivery is harmful while preserving catch-up for monitoring jobs.

options.title: Keep internal only
options.body: Leave current catch-up defaults unchanged and handle concrete duplicate-delivery bugs through narrower scheduler logic.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded global controls
recommendation.body: Add validated global cron settings for maximum immediate missed jobs and stagger delay while keeping current defaults and documenting that they defer rather than skip unless explicitly changed.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the merged restart-stagger history and are the best available routing owner for a public config-surface decision.
